title: Take from the ready-made
sub: Start from scratch and bring over only what you need from the samples, then remove the extra.

piece.title: A piece of the sheet
piece.sum: The sheet has the abilities from a sample, the extra field is removed, no errors.

effect.title: Effect
effect.sum: The “Disengage” effect is brought over together with what it cannot work without. No errors.

alone.title: On your own
alone.sum: You took a piece from another system and removed the extra from it.

take.lead: A copy of a sample takes everything: races, classes, dozens of other people's effects. Cleaning that up later is hard. It is easier to start from scratch and take only the pieces you need from the samples.
take.say: In the “Ready-made from samples” panel press the first piece in the list. It is six abilities with modifiers.
take.hint: Pieces are laid out by system, and the abilities piece is first in the list. A grey piece is already in the system.
take.result: The abilities are brought onto the sheet.

seen.say: On the plaque of the abilities piece marked “added” open “what came in”: everything that came with the piece is there — tables, fields, a die. “undo” returns the system as it was, but only until the next edit.
seen.result: You can see everything that came with the piece.

drop.hint: A grey “Delete” means the field is in use — it cannot be removed. “Inspiration” is free.
drop.field: On the sheet click the “Inspiration” field.
drop.trap: The “charisma” row is removed, and other parts of the system use it — “Problems” will show which. Put “charisma” back and remove “Inspiration”.
drop.result: “Inspiration” is removed, the rest is in place.

problems.say: Press the “No problems” button in the header (if something is found, it says “Problems” and a number). After the removal there should be no errors, and if something broke, it will say where.
problems.result: No problems. To close the list, press the same button again.

effect.lead: Effects are taken the same way. An effect brings with it what it cannot work without — for example, the cost of the action and the turn counters.
effect.say: In the “Nearby” panel on the “Ready-made” tab open “Individual effects” and press “Disengage”.
effect.hint: “Disengage” is from D&D 5e, in its “Individual effects”.
effect.ready: If “Trial” is open, press “Ready-made” in the “Nearby” panel.

came.say: Open “what came in”: together with “Disengage” came the “Cost: action” effect and the “Combat actions” folder.
came.result: You can see what came together with “Disengage”.

problemsEffect.say: Press the “No problems” button in the header (if something is found, it says “Problems” and a number). There should be no errors.

other.lead: The last task is without hints, with a piece from another system.
other.goal: the sheet has “Physical damage” from the piece “Health and stun tracks”, one of the fields “Wound penalty” and “Condition penalty” is removed, and “Problems” shows no errors.
other.say: Bring “Health and stun tracks” to the sheet and remove one unneeded field from them.
other.hint: The piece is in “Ready-made from samples”, under Shadowrun. You can remove “Wound penalty” or “Condition penalty”.
other.result: A piece from another system is brought, the extra is removed.
